securityConflicts.conflict: Android is a sandboxed app with manifest permissions and OS-enforced isolation. Full-trust desktop plugins assume Node built-ins, child processes, arbitrary host services and global network; these capabilities cannot be reproduced by silently widening Android app permissions.
securityConflicts.requiredDecision: Do not adopt full trust as an Android plugin security model. Define an explicit capability-gated workshop contract, preserve user-visible consent, and fail closed where the Android host cannot provide a capability. Record this as a cross-unit risk, not an S0.01 delivery claim.
